deck.empty: There is no profile for this device.
deck.editModeHint: Edit mode: tap a tile to edit it
deck.unpairConfirm: Forget this device? You will have to pair it again.

pairScreen.title: Connect to your PC
pairScreen.instructions: On the PC, open the OVSD tray icon menu → "Connect device" and type the code shown there (or scan the QR code).

pair.title: Connect a device
pair.instructions: Scan the code with your phone or tablet (same WiFi network), or open the address and enter the PIN.
pair.manual: Address to open on the device's browser:
pair.firewall: If it does not load, allow OVSD in Windows Firewall for private networks.

nav.openDeck: Open the deck in this browser

icons.refine: More results available: refine your search

appearance.imageHint: PNG, JPG, animated GIF, SVG… or {{media.art}} for the current album art.

macro.indexHint: Inside the loop, the variable index is 0, 1, 2…

gestureHelp.longPress: Hold (configurable in Settings). With actions here, the normal tap waits until you let go.
gestureHelp.doubleTap: Two quick taps. With actions here, the normal tap is slightly delayed.
gestureHelp.press: Right when touched, without waiting. Useful for push-to-talk together with "On release".
gestureHelp.release: Right when the finger is lifted.
gestureHelp.change: While dragging. The value is in the variable value (e.g. {{value}}).

concurrency.ignoreHelp: While running, new triggers are ignored.
concurrency.restartHelp: Cancels the current run and starts again.

state.noneHelp: The tile always looks the same.
state.toggleHelp: Each tap switches between off and on; define the "on" look.
state.expressionHelp: The state comes from an expression: true → "on", false → "off", or the text it returns.
state.appearanceFor: Look in state "{{state}}" (empty fields are inherited)

layout.valueExpressionHint: Expression giving the current position, e.g. audio.volume. Empty = last moved value.
layout.widgetExpressionHint: Sampled expression, e.g. sys.cpu or sys.gpu.temp.

editor.pagesHint: Folders get an automatic "back" tile. Drag a tile onto a page to move it there.
editor.backupsHint: Every save keeps the previous version (up to 50).
editor.deleteProfileConfirm: Delete profile "{{name}}"? You can recover it from a backup.
editor.gridHint: Click a tile to edit it or an empty cell to create one. Drag to move or swap. Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V / Ctrl+D / Del / Ctrl+Z.
editor.selectHint: Select a tile or an empty cell of the grid.
editor.overlapWarning: This tile overlaps another one or goes outside the grid.
editor.conflict: This profile was changed somewhere else.
editor.gridShrinkConfirm: {{count}} tiles outside the new grid will be deleted. Continue?

rules.title: Automatic switching
rules.help: Devices with "Automatic profile" switch to this profile when the PC's active app matches (process name, * allowed, and/or part of the window title).

devices.title: Devices
devices.help: Phones, tablets or browsers paired with this PC. Each can show a different profile.
devices.none: No devices yet. Click "Connect device" and scan the code with your phone.
devices.auto: Automatic profile from the active app
devices.removeConfirm: Unpair "{{name}}"? It will have to pair again.
devices.autoHelp: With automatic profile, the device follows each profile's rules and returns to its own profile when none matches.

settings.title: Settings
settings.defaultProfileHint: For devices without an assigned profile.
settings.cpuSensorsHint: CPU temperature requires running OVSD as administrator with the PawnIO driver installed.
settings.obsHint: In OBS: Tools → WebSocket Server Settings.
settings.subscriptionsHint: One topic per line (+ and # allowed). Each message is stored in the variable mqtt.<topic>.
settings.discordHelp: To mute/deafen with real state, create an application at discord.com/developers, add the redirect http://localhost and paste its Client ID and secret here. Discord asks for permission the first time. Without it: use hotkey actions with Discord's own shortcuts.
settings.webhooksHelp: Other apps can send data to OVSD with GET or POST to this address; the value ends up in the variable webhook.NAME.

variables.title: Variables
variables.help: Live values you can use in texts ({{name}}), conditions and states.

help.title: Help
help.templates: Any text, icon, color or image can include expressions between {{ }}; they update as soon as variables change.
help.expressions: Conditions, states and assignments use expressions: quoted texts, numbers, true/false, variables (names with unusual characters go in brackets: [mqtt.home/temp]), operators == != < <= > >= + - * / %, && || ! (or and/or/not), a ? b : c, ?? and functions.
help.mqttVar: last message of each subscribed topic
help.webhookVar: last data received by the webhook
help.userVar: your own variables; kept across restarts
help.gestures: Each tile can have different actions for tap, long press, double tap, press and release. Sliders send their value in the variable value.
